title: Should an AI working on a stage be stopped from setting or removing an "always use this answer" choice, or do we accept that risk for now?
context: A standing answer skips that question from then on. This change promises that only a person can choose one, but today only written instructions stop an AI working on a stage from choosing one by mistake. Recommended: stop it now. Stage agents already hand questions back rather than answer them, so they lose nothing they should be doing, and paqad already refuses one stage-agent action this way. This adds one refusal beyond issue 822. It stops mistakes rather than an agent set on getting round it, so proving a person answered stays out of scope and stays in tech debt.
